## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `piv-usaccess` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `piv-usaccess` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `piv-credential-issuance`, `piv-authentication-certificates`, `federal-common-policy-chain`, `ocsp-validation`, `crl-distribution`

**Validation artifacts:** `piv-credential-inventory.json`, `piv-validation-report.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/piv-usaccess/piv-usaccess.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `IA-2(1)`, `IA-2(2)`, `IA-5(2)`, `SC-12`, `SC-13`, `SC-17`, `PE-2`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **IA-2(1)** MFA — Privileged Accounts | Primary | PIV is the canonical federal-personnel MFA mechanism — multi-factor by construction (card + PIN). |
| **IA-2(2)** MFA — Non-Privileged Accounts | Primary | PIV covers all federal-personnel authentication tiers. |
| **IA-5(2)** PKI-Based Authentication | Primary | Certificate-chain validation against the Federal Common Policy CA is the canonical PKI-based authentication evidence. |
| **SC-12** Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Supporting | Per-credential public-key metadata is recorded; private-key material remains on the smartcard. |
| **SC-13** Cryptographic Protection | Supporting | Certificate-chain validation uses FIPS-validated cryptographic libraries. |
| **SC-17** Public Key Infrastructure Certificates | Primary | The adapter is the canonical observer of certificate state under the Federal Common Policy. |
| **PE-2** Physical Access Authorizations | Supporting | PIV credentials carry the visual / physical credential layer; the adapter records issuance and revocation that gates physical access. |

## Notes from canon

Federal Personal Identity Verification (FIPS 201-3) credential observer. Validates issuance authority, certificate chain to the Federal Common Policy CA, and revocation state via OCSP / CRL. Closes the HRIT IAM gap for OPM-user PIV-based authentication mandated by Solicitation 24322626R0007 Amd 4 Clause 1752.224-70(b) and the PWS p. 112 Zero Trust posture (PIV/CAC). Companion to ADR-051 (SAML trust anchor): the federal-personnel authentication chain is PIV-cert → SAML-assertion-to-OPM-Entra → Application Identity binding. Tier-1 conformance status: pending — likely EXCLUDED per UIAO_131 §5.1 (no public USAccess developer sandbox) with compensating evidence per §5.1.1 (vendor-attested test report from GSA OR agency-operated PIV smartcard fixture). Activation requires a per-adapter ADR modeled on ADR-035.
